params.body:
`portal:project-delete` removed the project, its updates, reports, admissions and requests, but not what is keyed by the slug or the job name instead of a foreign key:

- the measure job `measure:<slug>` in `job_runs` (and its `job_acknowledgements`)
- the uptime history in `uptime_ticks` and `uptime_hours`

That is why blitzt-website still shows in the fleet brief's job list with a run from 14 September while no such project exists, and why vera, dbc-webapplicatie and hoet-design-web would keep their measure jobs after being deleted.

What changes:

- Deleting a project now also deletes those rows, in the same transaction. The dry run lists them (`jobs`, `uptime`) next to the existing counts.
- A slug with no project but with leftovers (reports, a measure job, uptime rows) is no longer an error: the command lists what is left, and with `--confirm=<slug>` exports and removes it. Same lock as for a project; no money check, since money hangs on a project. A slug with nothing left still fails as before.
- `measure:<slug>` is matched exactly, so `measure:oud-ander` survives deleting `oud` (tested).

Tests: two new cases in `DeleteProjectTest` (7 pass). Full suite: 752 of 753 pass. The one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which also fails on main in a git worktree (`.git` is a file there), so it has nothing to do with this change. Pint is clean.

After merge, on the box: `php artisan portal:project-delete <slug>` (dry run) then `--confirm=<slug>`, for vera, dbc-webapplicatie, hoet-design-web and blitzt-website.
params.title: Delete a project's measure job and uptime history with it
